text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer

<username>.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I figured you would be here as you
weren't in your
room.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Have you made your first shrine visit for
the new
year? If not, would you like to
join me?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I know it's a little late for a first visit,
but
it's far
better than not going at all.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's a trainer's job to pray for the
safety
of their
racers.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I must do everything I can to avoid
having regrets
later.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Like when you wish you'd done
something
differently or that something
had turned out
another way.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I want to prevent any regrettable things
from happening, as much as
possible—both for the
sake of my racers
and for myself.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: It's a hard lesson I learned from my past.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but there is no end to learning. We
must
always strive to improve for our
students.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
To ensure that everyone who wishes to
race can
strive toward the future they
desire...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: I won't make the same mistakes again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see a strong resolve in her gaze as she
looks
high into the sky above.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: And that's why I must thank you.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Because I was able to learn so much from
the
honest approach you take with your
trainee.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Although I do think you venture out too
far at
times...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
As a fellow Tracen trainer,
I'll be sure to
caution
you whenever you do go
overboard, all right?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Well, here's to a—

text_block_list.name: Man with Headband
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, you two! Care to pound some
mochi?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Huh? Us?

text_block_list.name: Man with Headband
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you two! C'mon, you can eat what
you
make, and nothin' beats freshly
made mochi!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: B-but I... well...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Very well. I suppose it's not often we get an opportunity like this.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if I can even lift the mallet.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: Hrgh! Urk! Hnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I help her as she shakily wields the
mallet, and we
have fun making some
mochi together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling that our friendship will
only
continue to grow from here.
